notes.title: BeatShips leaves Early Access!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!
Thank you all who have been following us throughout the development of the game.
We have finally reached our objectives for this stage, so it is time to officially announce that we are LEAVING EARLY ACCESS!
Of course, this does not mean we will no longer improve the game, so don't stop sending your suggestions to us!!

1.0 version brings 30 new levels and more enemies, along with the Rocket and the UFO as new playable ships.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34837015/7d3770f0ddae415da6e63f15f58a8fb4ae348fab.gif

We hope you enjoy the new content!
- BeatShips Team

Remember to follow us in Discord to get new levels and share yours.

notes.title: Update QoL + Summer Sale -40% Combo!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34837015/b2f35f683dab4e2ad91baca87399f53ec321055f.gif

Update and Sale!

Quality of Life update is going to be live at the same time Steam Summer Sales fire off! We are really excited to finally be able to show all the work we have been doing. So, here is the list of everything:


 Tutorials!
 UI Unification
 UI Animations and Transitions
 New Reactive Hud
 New Depth Perception System
 Achievements!
 Resolution Selector
 FPS Limiter
 Localization (English/Spanish)
 Better Controller Support and Practices
 Steam Rich Presence Integration
 Trello Suggestions and BugTracking Integration
 Level Progress Tracker
 Skins affect lots of things!
 New Level Selector with more or less cool effects
 Way better Level Editor UI
 Level Editor - Try Level - button to try your level while editing it!
 Feedback on missed enemies
 Backgrounds change! (randomly)


There are less important things not listed here, and a hell of bugs that would require several pages to enumerate.

That's all, thank you for your time!

Remember to follow us in Discord to get new levels and share yours. Also check our Twitter for news and announcements.

notes.title: Launch Day Discount! 20% Off
notes.content:
BeatShips is now Live!

We are excited to finally be able to share our game with the world, and we want the maximum amount of people playing this first days.

That is why we are launching with a 20% discount! This will last for a week, so if you like the game, please share it with your friends as soon as possible so they can benefit of this discount too.


Thank you very much for your support.
